title: Coffee roaster in Ho Chi Minh City
subtitle: Sells robusta to cafés; bean prices are jumping
text: I roast robusta in Ho Chi Minh City and sell 1 kg bags to about 60 independent cafés, around 280 bags a week. A bag sells for $11 and the green beans plus packaging cost me about $6.50. Beans from the Central Highlands take about 3 weeks to arrive and I keep about 2 weeks of stock. My main rival is Highland Supply, who charge $10.50 a bag.
